OMV AG Announces Senior Appointment as Part of Leadership Strengthening

Vienna—OMV AG, a prominent player in Austria’s Oil & Gas Producers sector, has announced the appointment of Dr. Claudia Meier as Executive Vice President for Corporate Strategy, effective July 15. The move is seen by industry observers as a signal of the company’s commitment to advancing its long-term strategic goals amid a steadily evolving energy landscape.

Dr. Meier, who brings over 20 years of international experience in the energy industry, most recently held a senior leadership role at Vienna-based Enertech Solutions. Her appointment was approved unanimously by OMV AG’s Supervisory Board at its regular quarterly meeting on Tuesday.

“We are delighted to welcome Dr. Meier to OMV AG’s executive team,” said Chief Executive Officer Markus Weber at a press conference at the company’s headquarters in Vienna’s Leopoldstadt district. “Her background in both traditional and renewable energy, as well as her proven track record in guiding organizations through periods of transformation, make her a valuable addition as we continue to position OMV for sustainable growth.”

OMV AG has emphasized the importance of integrating new perspectives into its leadership as it pursues a balanced approach to energy production. The company, which employs around 20,000 people globally, has been expanding its portfolio to include investments in low-carbon technologies and alternative fuels, in line with Austria’s commitment to the European Union’s climate targets.

Industry analysts welcomed the appointment, noting Dr. Meier’s expertise in strategic planning and organizational change. “Dr. Meier’s leadership style is known for its focus on collaboration and innovation,” said Johannes Leitner, senior analyst at Austria Energy Forum. “Her arrival comes at a pivotal moment as OMV AG seeks to navigate the twin challenges of energy transition and market volatility.”

Dr. Meier expressed her enthusiasm in a statement released by the company: “I am honored to join OMV AG at such a dynamic time. I look forward to working with the leadership team and employees to further strengthen OMV’s role as a responsible and forward-looking energy provider.”

The Chamber of Commerce for Vienna also welcomed the news. “Senior appointments like this underscore the strength of Vienna as a hub for international energy expertise,” commented Chamber President Eva Gruber.

OMV AG confirmed that Dr. Meier will assume her new responsibilities following a transition period over the coming weeks.
